editorial:
Step into the tense world of border crime where an idealistic FBI agent named Kate gets pulled into a secret task force chasing cartel leaders. You follow her as the mission gets darker, the rules blur, and you wonder who is really in control. The movie feels gritty, serious, and packed with quiet dread, with strong performances and sharp action that keep you locked in.

You will love the acting, especially the calm menace of the mysterious Alejandro, and the slow build that makes every scene feel important. The downside is that it can feel heavy and bleak, with little humor and a story that leaves some questions open. If you enjoy smart crime thrillers, this is a strong pick. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Alejandro uses Kate to get close to the cartel boss and kills him and his family at dinner. Kate tries to stop him but fails, then signs a false report under threat. The movie ends with Alejandro walking away into the night, showing the mission was never about justice, just revenge and control.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves tense crime thrillers and strong performances.
